# DJ PAZO

> DJ PAZO is a professional DJ and MC based in Northwest Arkansas, curating music and unforgettable experiences for weddings, private events, nightlife, and celebrations. Every event receives its own custom-curated set.

Last updated: 2026-11-12

## Business identity

- Public brand: DJ PAZO
- Legal business name: Pazo Entertainment LLC
- Website: https://www.djpazo.com/
- Email: pazobeatzz@gmail.com
- Phone: +14794266076 ((479) 426-6076)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/DJ_Pazo_official/
- SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com/dj-pazo
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@pazobeats
- Base: Northwest Arkansas (NWA), Arkansas
- Regular service cities: Bentonville, Rogers, Fayetteville, Springdale, Arkansas
- Travel: Bookings outside Arkansas are welcome. Travel fees are assessed case by case, usually based on mileage.
- Languages: English and Conversational Spanish
- Experience: More than five years of DJ experience

## Services

DJ PAZO provides DJ and MC services for:

- Weddings & receptions
- Nightclubs & clubs
- Bars & restaurants
- Private parties
- Birthday parties
- Quinceañeras
- Corporate events
- School dances & proms
- College events
- Festivals
- Concerts & live events
- Holiday parties

Equipment can include a professional sound system, wireless microphones, DJ and moving-head lighting, ceremony audio, separate cocktail-hour audio, and backup equipment, depending on the event and package. Optional add-ons include extra hours, lighting upgrades, and dance-floor effects.

## Music and approach

Genres: Pop, 2000s & 2010s hits, EDM, House, Hip-hop, R&B, Latin, Top 40, Remixes, Throwbacks, Christian, Custom playlists.

DJ PAZO does not recycle playlists: music is curated around each event, its guests, and its atmosphere. Emphasis on reading the room, seamless transitions, technical mixing, MC services, and preparation. Song requests and must-play / do-not-play lists are welcome.

## Published pricing

- Private Events: $100 / hour + $150 flat fee
- Essential Wedding Reception: $795
- Signature Wedding Reception: $995

Full package inclusions: https://www.djpazo.com/llms-full.txt

Every event is different. Custom arrangements, add-ons like extra hours or lighting upgrades, and events outside these packages can be discussed through the contact form. Prices, package details, travel charges, deposits, and availability should be confirmed directly with DJ PAZO before booking.
